On-device AI experiences refer to situations where AI tasks are performed directly on a device rather than sending data to a cloud server for processing. This means the device uses its own processing power and local data to achieve AI-powered functionalities

The Advantages of Copilot+ PC: 1, Local Processing: On-device AI involves running AI models on the device itself, eliminating the need to send data to the cloud. 2, Enhanced Privacy: By processing data locally, users retain more control over their personal information and can avoid exposing it to potential security risks. 3, Faster Performance: On-device AI can lead to faster response times because there's no latency associated with data transmission to and from the cloud. 4, Offline Functionality: On-device AI allows AI-powered features to work even without an internet connection, making them more reliable in various situations. 5, Improved Security: Since data processing occurs locally, the risk of data breaches or hacking is reduced. 6, Power Efficiency: By reducing reliance on cloud processing, on-device AI can improve battery life on devices.

Switching out of S mode in Windows 11
Windows 11 in S mode is designed for security and performance, exclusively running apps from the Microsoft Store. If you want to install an app that isn't available in the Microsoft Store, you'll need to switch out of S mode

1. On your PC running Windows 11 in S mode, open Settings > System > Activation.

2. In the Switch to Windows 11 Pro section, select Go to the Store. (If you also see an "Upgrade your edition of Windows" section, be careful not to click the "Go to the Store" link that appears there.)

3. On the Switch out of S mode (or similar) page that appears in the Microsoft Store, select the Get button. After you see a confirmation message on the page, you'll be able to install apps from outside of the Microsoft Store.
